responsibility: This wrapper header implements GCC’s common include interposition logic for VxWorks standard library headers that need Dinkumware configuration setup first. For VxWorks 7 C++ compilations it includes GCC’s _yvals.h shim and then includes the real wrapped system header with __cplusplus temporarily undefined, so the underlying C library header is seen in the required mode; for other environments it simply forwards to the next header. It is the shared mechanism used by the neighboring wrapped headers such as complex.h, inttypes.h, and math.h.
